summary: Adds a new bundled agent guide for adopting Future Defaults, either after a version update or when the version is unchanged. The upgrade CLI copies it into the run directory and the prompt tells the agent to follow it, so it directly steers what the agent changes, commits and reports in a user's repository.
headline: New agent guide for adopting Future Defaults after optional version update
reason: Though a docs file, it is runtime instruction text fed to the upgrade agent and shapes automated edits to user repos, so a reviewer should judge the wording.
risk_signals: agent instructions shape automated changes to user repositories
focus: Instructions match the prompt built in next-upgrade.ts: future-defaults.md is read after the version guide, and shared.md is the delivery step
Guidance to skip experimental.agenticAutoUpgrade on unsupported versions matches the other guides
The adoption and verification order is consistent with the commit grouping in shared.md
